requirements.assertion: Independent numerical oracle for row/column/scalar/no broadcast; add/sub overwrite and accumulation; independent A/B/Dst placement; source and full-Dst poison guards; BF16 sources with BF16 and FP32 Dst.
requirements.gaps: Only selected address/fidelity recipes and finite values. Other formats, NaN/Inf/denormals, clear_dvalid combinations, rounding and full address-modifier state transitions remain.

requirements.assertion: Explicit dot-product/max host oracles, selected LoFi/HiFi2 schedules, placements and both Dst formats; checks all Dst tiles and source buffers.
requirements.gaps: Not complete fidelity/format coverage. Pool indices, address modifiers, valid flags, extrema and all reduction modes remain.

requirements.assertion: Selected row-group copies and single-row zeroing; independent placements, FP32-to-BF16 narrowing, full-Dst/source preservation.
requirements.gaps: Other move modes and ZEROACC clear-mode/zero-flag combinations remain. ZEROACC use as fixture initialization is not additional proof.

requirements.assertion: Finite arithmetic against FP64-derived expected values; subtraction modifier, masks, placement, destination/source aliases and repeated operations.
requirements.gaps: Tolerance comparisons do not prove the documented partially fused bit-exact FMA model. Full sign/indirection combinations and IEEE exceptional behavior remain.

requirements.assertion: Native/refined reciprocal and exponential paths, exponent/domain boundaries and accuracy checks.
requirements.gaps: Exception-characterization output alone is not conformance. Exact documented special values, all modifiers and PRNG/config interactions remain.

requirements.assertion: Per-lane FP32 mapping, all exposed source LRegs copied to L0-L7, self aliases, explicitly programmed configurable constants, full-Dst poison preservation.
requirements.gaps: Most format/address modes, backdoor loads, config-register readback, PRNG and macro-template combinations remain.

requirements.assertion: Raw versus ordinary store bit patterns, signed zero, subnormals, infinities and a NaN payload, with full-Dst checks.
requirements.gaps: Selected modes and values only; does not cover all integer/narrowing/partial-word formats.

requirements.assertion: Inactive-lane preservation for load/store/add/immediate/copy; all-off, all-on, alternating and every single-lane mask; following unmasked operation verifies reset.
requirements.gaps: Not all modifier/format combinations or latent flag states are checked.

requirements.assertion: Separately verifies load and store column-override bits, low address bits and all individual exchange-mask bits, with placement guards.
requirements.gaps: Selected FP32 transfer mode; other formats and configuration combinations remain.

requirements.assertion: Modes 0-9, value and paired-index results, lane min/max masks, exchange inversion, ties, signed zeros and predication.
requirements.gaps: NaN payload ordering, all aliases, all config/modifier cross-products and documented scheduling hazards remain.

requirements.assertion: Checks captured physical Dst row/column indices at low, unaligned and high rows.
requirements.gaps: Other transfer formats, interactions with masking, and complete index configuration remain.

requirements.assertion: Full-Dst scale-by-two oracle for explicit, serial/pipelined macro, explicit replay and macro replay schedules, with rotating registers.
requirements.gaps: One macro recipe only. Other sub-units, conversion/rounding templates, sequence slots, delays, MOP masks and replay controls remain.

requirements.assertion: Runtime row counts, Dst offsets, FP32/BF16 output and exact payload/guard checks.
requirements.gaps: Other formats, compression, contexts and complete PACR modifier combinations remain.

requirements.assertion: Selected ReLU/clamp configurations checked as an independent partial pack kernel.
requirements.gaps: All thresholds, formats, exceptional values and modifier interactions remain.

requirements.assertion: Deterministic tie-away rounding oracle; stochastic neighbor bounds, same-seed repeatability and different-seed changes.
requirements.gaps: Does not prove distribution/unbiasedness or SFPU stochastic-round instruction behavior.

requirements.assertion: E4M3 normal payloads, tail padding limits and explicit mantissa truncation oracle.
requirements.gaps: Subnormal-preservation expectation is a strict expected failure, not a passing contract. Other formats and edge cases remain.

requirements.assertion: One/four interfaces, contiguous/reverse/irregular/repeated Dst order, both Dst and output formats, exact tails and wrapping output CB.
requirements.gaps: Other context/address/format combinations, compression and stream-driven packing remain.

requirements.assertion: Repeated writes accumulate values at reused L1 destinations for FP32/BF16 and several lengths.
requirements.gaps: Overflow, saturation, exceptional values and other accumulation configurations remain.

requirements.assertion: Direct-to-Dst and source-mediated paths, exact FP32 precision checks, BF16 source placement, full/partial runtime counts and both unpackers.
requirements.gaps: Full format/context/broadcast/transpose/tilize/cache-flush and address-counter semantics remain.

requirements.assertion: E4M3 source-bank payloads, parallel banks and conversion paths, including explicit subnormal cleanup comparison.
requirements.gaps: Expected failures and normal-only input selections must remain visible. No claim for all FP8 encodings.

requirements.assertion: Independent payload and poison guards for every configured runtime prefix; checks unowned source/Dst preservation.
requirements.gaps: TRANSPORT_LENGTHS can restrict the sweep; evidence must record the environment. Narrow format/recipe scope, not general modifiers.

requirements.assertion: Scattered source allocations and matrix pairs, native and staged paths, scattered Dst output with independent layout oracle.
requirements.gaps: Selected address recipes do not prove complete address-counter/context semantics.

requirements.assertion: Selected semaphore counts, untouched sentinel semaphore, ready/space conditions and a delayed peer proof that waits really block.
requirements.gaps: All masks, saturation boundaries, maxima and resource-mask combinations need additional tests.

requirements.assertion: Repeated source publish/wait/release cycles preserve payload; delayed peer checks wait-valid blocking for A and B.
requirements.gaps: Not all source-bank selectors, clear modes or STALLWAIT resource masks. Completion alone does not prove every flag transition.

requirements.assertion: All 256 semaphore masks on all three issuing threads; empty-mask no-op, unselected semaphore preservation, zero/fifteen saturation and increment past configured Max.
requirements.gaps: Boundary Value/Max pairs are selected, not exhaustive. Concurrent updates and all Max values remain.

requirements.assertion: Condition masks 1/2/3, both endpoints for combined condition, several multi-semaphore masks and all directed thread-cycle pairs. Partial peer release must not unblock before the last selected semaphore becomes ready.
requirements.gaps: Only the Sync block bit is used. Other resource block masks, wait replacement and zero BlockMask remain.

requirements.assertion: All four valid Blackhole mutex indices; two/three contending threads increment shared memory under the mutex with an exact final-count oracle; same-owner reacquisition must allow one release.
requirements.gaps: Round-robin fairness and release by a non-owner remain. Invalid mutex indices intentionally hang and are not executed.

requirements.assertion: Integer-to-FP32 nearest-even rounding at representability boundaries and ties, both signs including negative zero; stochastic results must be adjacent representable neighbors. Checks aliases, masks and raw 32-bit results.
requirements.gaps: Stochastic probability distribution, exact PRNG sequence and reduced PRNG precision are not proved by neighbor bounds.

requirements.assertion: Register/immediate scalar arithmetic, all documented ALU selectors, aliases, GPR bank boundaries, all three threads, intermediate results and final 64-GPR contents.
requirements.gaps: Exhaustive operand combinations, concurrent threads and scheduling hazards remain.

requirements.assertion: Selected mode/immediate cross-products with integer/FP bit edges, aliases, all/none/half masks and observed flags.
requirements.gaps: Lane-varying indirect indices, full register/configuration space, cast rounding and interactions remain.

requirements.assertion: All push/pop/comparison-stack modifiers and truth tables over selected depths including eight; observed masks and complement, deeper-stack preservation.
requirements.gaps: Latent flags while predication is disabled are not fully observed; nonuniform lane stacks and backdoor configuration remain.

parametrize: pytest.mark.parametrize('operation,name,a_slots,b_slots', [pytest.param(op, name, a, b, id=f'{op}-{name}') for op in ('ELWADD', 'MVMUL', 'GAPOOL', 'GMPOOL') for name, a, b in CASES] + [pytest.param(op, 'odd counter rounds down', (1, 5), (7, 0), id=f'{op}-odd-counter-rounds-down') for op in ('MVMUL', 'GAPOOL')])
pytest.mark.parametrize('name,a_slots,b_slots', CASES, ids=[case[0] for case in CASES])
pytest.mark.parametrize('passes,final_acc,ring', ((1, False, False), (1, True, False), (2, False, False), (2, True, False), (2, False, True)))

pytest.mark.parametrize(('tile', 'output_format', 'count', 'offset', 'output'), [(0, BF16, 1, 0, CB_PAGES[0]), (1, BF16, 7, 16, CB_PAGES[1]), (2, BF16, 16, 0, CB_PAGES[2]), (3, BF16, 17, 32, CB_PAGES[0]), (4, BF16, 128, 16, CB_PAGES[1]), (5, BF16, 137, 144, CB_PAGES[2]), (6, BF16, 512, 128, CB_PAGES[0]), (7, BF16, TILE_ELEMENTS, 0, CB_PAGES[1]), (0, F32, 1, 0, CB_PAGES[2]), (3, F32, 17, 16, CB_PAGES[0]), (5, F32, 137, 144, CB_PAGES[1]), (7, F32, TILE_ELEMENTS, 0, CB_PAGES[2])])

pytest.mark.parametrize(('mode', 'upper', 'output_format', 'count', 'offset'), [('relu', None, BF16, 17, 16), ('relu', None, F32, 137, 32), ('clamp', 1.5, BF16, 137, 32), ('clamp', 1.5, F32, 17, 16)])
pytest.mark.parametrize('mask', (0, 255, 85, 170, *(1 << i for i in range(8))), ids=lambda mask: f'mask-{mask:02x}')

pytest.mark.parametrize('seed', (0, 91, pytest.param(-1, id='subnormals', marks=pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, raises=AssertionError, reason='Blackhole E4M3 unpack does not preserve standard subnormals'))))
pytest.mark.parametrize('op,alias', [pytest.param(op, alias, id=f'{alias}-{op}') for alias in ('other', 'addend', 'all') for op in ('add', 'sub', 'mul', 'mad') if alias != 'all' or op == 'mad'])

pytest.mark.parametrize('slots,lengths', [pytest.param((0, 1, 2, 3), (128,) * 4, id='contiguous'), pytest.param((63, 0, 31, 4), (128,) * 4, id='irregular'), pytest.param((63, 62, 61, 60), (128,) * 4, id='reverse'), pytest.param((63, 0, 31, 4), (1, 17, 73, 127), id='short-segments'), pytest.param((63, 0, 31, 4, 57, 8), (128,) * 6, id='six-segments')])
